name: ultrachess
description: Ultra-fast WASM-first chess library (Rust core + TypeScript shim).

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p ultrachess-wasm && mkdir -p assets && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/ultrachess_wasm.wasm assets/ultrachess.wasm && (command -v wasm-opt >/dev/null && wasm-opt -O4 --enable-bulk-memory --strip-debug --strip-producers assets/ultrachess.wasm -o assets/ultrachess.wasm.opt && mv assets/ultrachess.wasm.opt assets/ultrachess.wasm || true)
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:inline && npm run build:ts
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:inline && npm run test:ts
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage:rs && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:inline && npm run coverage:ts
scripts.check: npm run fmt:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
